description:
Experienced IT professional originally from Colombia, now succeeding in the German IT sector. Began career as an IT Support/Service Engineer in media technology, gaining experience in networking, WLAN setups, event support, network patching, technical room maintenance, file backups, and troubleshooting technical issues.
Completed a Java Full-Stack Developer Bootcamp with Academic Work and Brights Learning, acquiring proficiency in Spring and Angular frameworks, backend development with Java, and frontend skills in CSS, HTML, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Currently employed as a Full Stack Engineer/DevOps, specializing in Python, Angular, AWS, Terraform, Jira, GraphQL, and One M2M-SIM for network solutions. Committed to continuous skill development.
Pursuing a degree in Computer Science remotely at Universidad Remington in Colombia.
Key skills include: Python, Angular, AWS, Terraform, Jira, GraphQL, Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, DevOps, networking, WLAN setups, troubleshooting, file backups, technical maintenance, Go (Golang), and React.
